wyr.q1: Would you rather never be able to lie again or never be able to keep a secret?
wyr.q1a: Never be able to lie again
wyr.q1b: Never be able to keep a secret
wyr.q2: Would you rather relive your first date forever or never have an argument?
wyr.q3: Would you rather your partner read all your thoughts for a day or meet all your exes?
wyr.q3a: They read all my thoughts for a day
wyr.q4: Would you rather always be right in arguments or never go to bed angry?
wyr.q5: Would you rather live in a small city apartment with your partner or in a big house in the countryside without them during the week?
wyr.q5b: A big house in the countryside without them during the week
wyr.q6: Would you rather your partner cook every meal (even if it's mediocre) or eat out every night (but never have a home-cooked meal)?
wyr.q6a: They cook every meal (even if it's mediocre)
wyr.q6b: Eat out every night (but never a home-cooked meal)
wyr.q7: Would you rather receive a long love letter every day or a single 10-minute cuddle every evening?
wyr.q7a: A long love letter every day
wyr.q8: Would you rather know the exact date of your breakup (if it happens) or never know?
wyr.q9: Would you rather your partner be very jealous but extremely caring or completely indifferent but super chill?
wyr.q10: Would you rather lose all your couple photos or lose all your messages to each other?
wyr.q10b: Lose all our messages to each other
wyr.q11: Would you rather have a perfect but boring relationship or an imperfect but passionate one?
wyr.q12: Would you rather never be able to say "I love you" but show it or say it 100 times a day but never show it?
wyr.q12a: Never say it but show it
wyr.q12b: Say it 100 times a day but never show it
wyr.q13: Would you rather your partner become famous and travel all the time or stay unknown but always be around?
wyr.q14: Would you rather have a partner who's always right or a partner who always makes you laugh?
wyr.q14b: A partner who always makes me laugh
wyr.q15: Would you rather relive your best memory together or erase your worst argument?
wyr.q16: Would you rather your partner plan everything in your life or never plan anything and improvise everything?
wyr.q16a: They plan everything in our life
wyr.q16b: Never plan anything and improvise everything
wyr.q17: Would you rather have to dance together in public every time you enter a store or sing a love song to each other at restaurants?
wyr.q17a: Dance together every time we enter a store
wyr.q17b: Sing a love song to each other at restaurants
wyr.q18: Would you rather only communicate by text for a week or only communicate by whispering for a month?
wyr.q18a: Only by text for a week
wyr.q18b: Only by whispering for a month
wyr.q19: Would you rather your partner be brutally honest even when it hurts or always soften the truth to spare your feelings?
wyr.q19a: Brutally honest even when it hurts
wyr.q20: Would you rather move abroad together to an unknown country or stay in the same place your whole life?
wyr.q20a: Move abroad to an unknown country
wyr.q20b: Stay in the same place our whole life
wyr.q21: Would you rather swap bodies with your partner for 24 hours or read their mind for 1 hour?
wyr.q22: Would you rather have lots of money but little time together or little money but all the free time in the world?
wyr.q22a: Lots of money but little time together
wyr.q22b: Little money but all the free time in the world
wyr.q23: Would you rather your partner have the same job as you or a completely different one?
wyr.q24: Would you rather grow old but never lose your bond or stay young but with a relationship that fades?
wyr.q24a: Grow old but never lose our bond
wyr.q24b: Stay young but with a relationship that fades
wyr.q25: Would you rather never be able to give gifts or never receive them?
wyr.q25a: Never be able to give gifts
wyr.q26: Would you rather have a partner who snores loudly but gives the best cuddles or a silent sleeper who stays on their side?
wyr.q26a: Snores loudly but gives the best cuddles
wyr.q26b: Silent sleeper who stays on their side
wyr.q27: Would you rather your partner be better than you at everything or you be better than them at everything?
wyr.q27a: They're better than me at everything
wyr.q27b: I'm better than them at everything
wyr.q28: Would you rather your families not get along at all or your friends not stand each other?
wyr.q28b: Our friends don't stand each other
wyr.q29: Would you rather have a very ambitious partner who's often away or a very present partner with no big ambitions?
wyr.q29b: Very present but no big ambitions
wyr.q30: Would you rather know what your partner truly thinks of you or keep some mystery?
wyr.q30a: Know what they truly think of me
